REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - APRIL 1, 2026 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Community Development Department, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Development Department during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to planning@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 4.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to planning@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact City of Cerritos ADA/504 Coordinator, Drew Schneider, at (562) 916-1314 at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Pledge of Allegiance
3.
Roll Call
4.
Public Comments and Suggestions
This section is reserved for public comment on Consent Calendar and items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission. Verbal comments may be limited to three minutes per speaker, subject to the Chair extending to a maximum of five minutes per speaker, with a total time allotted not to exceed 45 minutes unless the Chair extends.
5.
Consent Calendar
Items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the Commission, there will be no separate discussion of these items. If a Commission member requests separate consideration, the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.
5A.
Approval of Minutes
Regular Meeting Minutes of March 4, 2026

THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (RS-5000) (APN 7028-022-006).*

New & Old

Agenda Report
8.

8A.
Reports from Designated Commission Staff Liaison
During this part of the meeting, designated staff will have an opportunity to report on various City matters and/or respond verbally to questions or comments from the prior meeting, including any request by members to provide a brief supplemental report or brief follow-up response to items from the prior meeting agenda.
8B.
Reports from Planning Commission Members
During this part of the meeting, members may provide brief reports to the community on various matters of interest, including any mandated reports required by AB 1234. Pursuant to the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act and the City of Cerritos Commission and Committee Scope of Authority Policy, there may be no discussion or action taken on any matters presented during this item or that are not listed on the meeting agenda.
9.

CITY OF CERRITOS

  MINUTES

Regular Planning Commission Meeting
April 1, 2026
City Council Chambers
18125 Bloomfield Ave
Cerritos, California 90703

PRESENT:  Commissioner Benjamin Ao
  Commissioner Kiritkumar Chauhan
  Commissioner Riaz Surti
  Vice Chair Deepak “DJ” Jhaveri
  Chair Jose “Armin” Reyes

PRESENT:  Assistant City Attorney Shukan Patel
  Director of Community Development Sabrina Chan
  Director of Public Works/City Engineer Alvin Papa
  Current Planning Manager Amanda Acuña
  Parks & Trees Superintendent Jorge Martinez
  Parks & Trees Supervisor/ City Arborist Bino Holguin
  Associate Planner Metré Anthony
  Associate Planner Wyman Wong

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Commissioner Chauhan.

3.  Roll Call

  All Members of the Planning Commission were declared present.

4.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Chair Reyes invited comments and suggestions from the public on items not listed on
  the agenda. Seeing and hearing no speakers wishing to address the Planning
  Commission, Chair Reyes closed public comments.

5.  Consent Calendar

5A.  Approval of Minutes

  Wednesday, March 4, 2026, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Ao, and seconded by Commissioner
  Chauhan, to approve the Wednesday, March 4, 2026, 7:00 p.m. Planning
  Commission Regular Meeting Minutes.

City of Cerritos  April 1, 2026
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 1
   The motion carried (5-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Surti, Jhaveri, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

6.  Public Hearings

6A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 2026-4, A
  PROPOSAL BY THE RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY OWNERS TO CONSTRUCT A FIRST-
  FLOOR ADDITION AND A NEW SECOND FLOOR TO AN EXISTING SINGLE-STORY
  RESIDENCE WITH AN ATTACHED TWO-CAR GARAGE AT 18814 QUEENS COURT,
  CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY
  RESIDENTIAL (RS-5000) (APN 7028-003-021).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  A staff report was given by Associate Planner Wyman Wong. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed, providing details about the proposed project and existing
  property conditions. Mr. Wong continued providing details about the proposed
  construction of a first-floor addition and a new second floor to an existing single-
  story residence, with an attached two-car garage, on a 5,351-square-foot property.
  Mr. Wong concluded his presentation by stating that the project applicant is available
  to answer any questions the Commission may have.

  Chair Reyes opened the public hearing. Seeing and hearing no speakers wishing to
  address the Planning Commission, Chair Reyes closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vice Chair Jhaveri and seconded by Commissioner Ao to
  waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2026-13: RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 2026-4, A
  PROPOSAL BY THE RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY OWNERS TO CONSTRUCT A FIRST-
  FLOOR ADDITION AND A NEW SECOND FLOOR TO AN EXISTING SINGLE-STORY
  RESIDENCE WITH AN ATTACHED TWO-CAR GARAGE AT 18814 QUEENS COURT,
  CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY
  RESIDENTIAL (RS-5000) (APN 7028-003-021).

  The motion carried (5-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Surti, Jhaveri, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

6B.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF PRECISE PLAN
  2026-5, A PROPOSAL BY THE RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY OWNERS TO CONSTRUCT A
  FIRST-FLOOR ADDITION AND A NEW SECOND FLOOR TO AN EXISTING SINGLE-
  STORY RESIDENCE AT 18732 VIKINGS WAY, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE

City of Cerritos  April 1, 2026
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 2
   SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (RS-5000) (APN 7028-
  022-006).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  A staff report was given by Associate Planner Metré Anthony. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed, providing details about the proposed project and existing
  property conditions. Mr. Anthony continued his presentation, providing details about
  the proposed construction of a 17-square-foot first-floor addition and a new 876-
  square-foot second floor to an existing single-story residence.

  Chair Reyes opened the public hearing. Seeing and hearing no speakers wishing to
  address the Planning Commission, Chair Reyes closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vice Chair Jhaveri and seconded by Commissioner
  Chauhan to waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2026-14: A RESOLUTION
  OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF
  PRECISE PLAN 2026-5, A PROPOSAL BY THE RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY OWNERS TO
  CONSTRUCT A FIRST-FLOOR ADDITION AND A NEW SECOND FLOOR TO AN
  EXISTING SINGLE-STORY RESIDENCE AT 18732 VIKINGS WAY, CERRITOS,
  CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY
  RESIDENTIAL (RS-5000) (APN 7028-022-006).

  The motion carried (5-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Surti, Jhaveri, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7A.  Review and consideration of an informational report related to tree care within the
  City of Cerritos.

  An informational report was given by Parks and Trees Superintendent Jorge
  Martinez. A PowerPoint presentation was displayed, providing details on tree care
  within the City of Cerritos and on maintenance responsibilities. Mr. Martinez
  continued his presentation by providing details on where residents can find additional
  information on tree care, responsibility of parkway trees, and City-maintained trees.

  Discussion continued regarding the tree removal process, costs associated with tree
  removal, responsibility of tree replacement, and tree trimming guidelines.

  Chair Reyes opened the public hearing. Seeing and hearing no speakers wishing to
  address the Planning Commission, Chair Reyes closed public comments.

8.  Reports

8A.  Reports from Designated Commission Liaison

  There were no reports from the Designated Commission Liaison to the Planning
  Commission.

 8B.  Reports from Planning Commission Members

  Reports were given by Commissioner Ao, Commissioner Chauhan, Commissioner
  Surti, Vice Chair Jhaveri, and Chair Reyes.

9.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 8:15 p.m.
